accuracy_notes: Photo-informed original artwork: Carcharhinus melanopterus visual study. Animated tail and fins; not a scanned specimen or taxonomic identification model. Original Carcharhinus melanopterus visual study based on the inspected Klaus Stiefel photograph. Gill slits and closed ventral mouth use shallow authored relief rather than open cavities; fine denticles and teeth are simplified. Swimming is artist-tuned, not measured behavior.

attribution.credit: Original Blender geometry and textures for this gallery. Reference photos guide appearance and are not embedded.
